svg.title: Same Call, Two Paths
svg.desc: The same generateText() call to Groq/xAI reached two ways: directly, where the browser's HTTP request stays open until the call finishes, versus via Inngest, where the browser gets an immediate queued response and the call runs later inside a retryable step.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Same Call, Two Paths

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Both paths below make the exact same generateText() call to Groq/xAI — the only thing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: that changes is where that call sits and who waits for it. One is real code in this app today;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: the other is illustrative, showing how the same call would look wrapped in an Inngest

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: showing the identical call wrapped in an Inngest step.run(), reached only after the browser has already gotten an unrelated, immediate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: “queued” response.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing on the right side exists in my_polaris yet — route.ts's functions: [] is still empty. This diagram shows what plugging in one real job

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: would look like, using the same generateText() call already built for the blocking demo.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: SAME WORK, DIFFERENT WAITING

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Both paths call the identical generateText(). The only thing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: that changes is whether the browser's HTTP request stays

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: open for it (left) or gets an unrelated instant reply while the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: call happens later (right).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: FAILURE HANDLING

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: On the left, a Groq timeout or error fails the whole request —

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: the browser sees an error, nothing retries automatically. On

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: the right, Inngest retries just the failed step.run(), without

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: re-sending the event or re-running earlier steps.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: WHERE THE RESULT GOES

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: The left path's result flows straight back in the same response.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: The right path's result is saved by Inngest as durable step

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: state — getting it to the browser needs a separate channel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: (polling, a webhook, a DB write) that isn't shown here.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: WHEN EACH MAKES SENSE

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Direct suits fast, single-shot calls where the user is actively

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: waiting (exactly what the demo pages do today). Inngest suits

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: slow, retry-worthy, or multi-step work the user shouldn't have

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: to sit through.
